name: black-pill-f401
description: WeAct-style Black Pill marked stm32f401/411 v1204 (STM32F401RCT6, 256KB flash / 64KB SRAM), HSE 25MHz -> PLL (M=25,N=336,P=4) = 84MHz. Active-low LED on PC13 on this revision (some revisions use PA5). KEY button on PA0. Console USART1: TX PA9 / RX PA10 @115200. I2C1 SCL PB6 / SDA PB7, I2C2 SCL PB10 / SDA PB11. Pin numbers use port*16+pin (PA0..15=0..15, PB=16..31, PC=32..47). Flash via SWD or the ROM DFU bootloader (hold BOOT0); the linked final.bin image goes to 0x08000000.
